Pursuant to the NCLT Order and the effectiveness of the Scheme, the Authorised Share Capital of the Company stands increased to ? 550,00,00,000 divided into 55,00,00,000. Further, the Board based on recommendation of the Board Nomination and Remuneration Committee, has approved grant of 75,000 stock options to eligible employees of the Company under the ICICI Lombard Employees Stock Option Scheme-2005.
